blocks.x: Today is February 15th, 2011, the anniversary of the sinking of the USS Maine just to give us some context, right?
Why didn’t that stir me at all?
[Laughs] We’re here once again in Lee Konitz’ apartment in Manhattan. I’m Bill Kirchner and we’re going to continue our interview.
